newsitem.title: USA: Cellular Tech sees Q3, Q4 below views.
newsitem.headline: Cellular Tech sees Q3, Q4 below views.

text.p: Cellular Technical Services Co Inc said Thursday that it expects third and fourth quarter results to be below analysts' expectations.

"Based on the current level of business activity, we believe that financial results for the third and fourth quarters will be below analysts' prior forecasts," said Stephen Katz, chairman and chief executive officer, in a press release.
Cellular reported a second quarter loss of $0.04 a share, compared to a loss of $0.09 a share the previous second quarter.
"Despite the positive comparison with the prior year period, our second quarter results were substantially below our expectations," Katz said.

The company said the second quarter shortfall was primarily the result of order delays for its Blackbird Platform system related to the late deployment of its latest software release and delays in signing new domestic and international contracts.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate for Cellular Technical is a profit of $0.15 a share for the third quarter and a profit of $0.17 for the fourth quarter.
